name: Power of Love
description: A group of competitive women and men come together in The Power of Love to find their dream partner. Every week, some contestants win the weekly prize, while others say goodbye to their dreams of love and the house. Emotional moments, surprises, and exciting challenges await in this thrilling season!

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Power of Love returns, hosted by Öykü Serter. New contestants join an exciting season. Nine women and nine men are introduced. First glances and flirtations start. Men visit women's homes. Who will be favorites and chosen for romantic dinners? First glance, first excitement.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The Power of Love continues with full excitement! Women contestants visit the men's house this time. They will introduce themselves in 3 minutes and answer the men's questions. Favorites are chosen, questions keep coming. Who will the woman choose for a romantic dinner? Surprises await in episode two!

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The red room doors open! Male contestants invite the women they like. The first excitement and sparks begin here. In five-minute meetings, feelings are shared and hearts will speak. Which woman will be invited again and again? With the first red rooms, the first couples start to form.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: It's the women's turn in the red room! They invite the men they like and express their feelings. Will Şura invite Barış? Are there others interested in Barış? Is love starting or hearts breaking? In this episode, feelings come to light, first loves blossom, and the red room remains the center of love!

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In The Power of Love, the houses unite. Belis and Ayla face their first big argument, yellow card risk is near. While Umut approaches Buket, is Barış's heart with Belis? As the first couples walk down hand in hand, favorites meet at a romantic dinner. The chaotic, loving, and exciting fifth episode is here!

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It's gala time on The Power of Love! One contestant will be eliminated, another wins the weekly prize. How will Barış face Belis's true feelings? Will Perinaz and Kerem find love? Groups form, alliances build. Who is protected? Who gets eliminated? An exciting elimination and reward night begins!

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: After the elimination night, the waters don't settle in the Power Of Love house. Barış nominating Şura for elimination causes a stir. As tension rises, Barış quickly draws attention from Esin. Will he open his heart to Feyza? In this episode of love, friendship, and strategy, nothing in the house will remain the same!

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Tension is high this week in the Power Of Love house! Complaints from the women's house to the men's. Jealousy sparks between Kerem and Perinaz. Tension continues between Belis and Şura. Are Barış and Belis getting closer? Öykü Serter brings excitement with surprise cards in the women's house. Red Room action doesn't slow down!

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A surprise-filled episode in the Power Of Love house! Tension rises as men enter the women's house. Some are happy, others uncomfortable. Trust crises arise; a shocking argument happens between Umut and Barış Esin. Büşra's feelings are mixed. The closeness of Şura, Belis, and Barış stirs storms. Love and friendship are tested!

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Heart rates are rising in the Kısmetse Olur house as relationships grow more complicated. Is there a new spark between Şura and Savaş? Tension between Umut and Fatih sends cold winds through the men’s house. Buket feels misunderstood. In the race between love and strategy, who will come out on top? Will hearts grow stronger or be broken?

videos.title: Episode 11

Love, jealousy, and strategy meet in episode 11!
